trailhead.name: Big Pine Creek South Fork Trailhead (Glacier Lodge road, Big Pine Creek)

identifiedBy.fact: party started at the backpacker lot on Glacier Lodge road, South Fork trail to Brainerd Lake, Finger Lake, then Middle Palisade Glacier side to Disappointment

placements.name: BIG PINE CREEK SO FORK TH

otherFacts.value: South Fork trail to Brainerd Lake, use trail to Finger Lake, cross-country to Middle Palisade Glacier

notes: Opened climber.org 2008/1665 (Glacier Lodge South Fork TH) and snwburd.com balcony_1 (Big Pine Creek TH, South Fork Trail, Brainerd/Finger Lake, Middle Palisade Glacier). Peak has one road access (Big Pine Creek); both used South Fork, not North Fork. Both are traverses via Balcony Peak rather than a named standard route, so moderate. SummitPost 403 not used.

Opened climber.org 2006/1546: park near Faucherie Lake Rd / Jackson Creek Campground junction (Lake Bowman Rd, FS 18), road FS 843 then old logging road, ~2 h; same page: another climber used Henness Pass Rd toward Catfish Lake. Opened tedmuller.us 2015: easiest is CR-843 past Catfish Lake to locked gate on CR-84320 (~1300 ft gain), his own hike began at Faucherie Lake Dam trailhead. Three different starts in use, none a signed trailhead, nothing ties the route to one. No coordinate.

Nothing new. Opened wacziarg 2021 report: Sunrise Lakes trailhead, north ridge class 2-3, descended east face. Earlier passes: Isberg Pass TH (themtsarecalling, pantilat), Tuolumne 1999. Starts in use: Isberg Pass TH, Sunrise Lakes TH, Tuolumne Meadows, Devils Postpile; nothing calls one the usual. Isberg not in officialCandidates.

trailhead.name: Granite Chief Trailhead (behind Olympic Valley fire station, at the ski area parking lot)

identifiedBy.fact: trail from behind the fire station along the ski area boundary to the PCT; Wikipedia Granite Chief Wilderness: Granite Chief trailhead at Squaw Valley Ski Area parking lot

notes: Route text names it; opened en.wikipedia Granite Chief Wilderness (trailhead at ski area lot, most used, no coordinate). Search summary of a Tahoe NF page said trail begins just behind the fire station, park across the road; the USFS PDF (fs.usda.gov/media/234184) would not parse and the granite-chief-trailhead page 404'd, so that is not evidence. No allowed-source coordinate found; no officialCandidates match.

Downgraded from found. Opened climber.org 2012/1806: trailhead Meysan Lake (Whitney Portal), camp Soldier Lake, day hike down to Rock Creek then south slopes. Opened climber.org 2003/1067: New Army (Cottonwood Lakes) TH, Soldier Lake. Starts in use: Cottonwood Lakes TH (USFS 36.453362,-118.169987), Cottonwood Pass TH (36.448305,-118.170612), Whitney Portal/Meysan. No page ties the route to one. climber.org SierraPeaks 03/07 gives no approach.

identifiedBy.fact: trailhead at the saddle on Canebrake Road, lot west side, trail east side; matches route text; no other Lamont start listed

notes: Opened climber.org/driving/canebrake.html (waypoint CANLAM, ~7 mi north of Hwy 178 junction). Search summary (not opened) of SummitPost/calipidder agrees. Single access. Only coordinate known is a climber.org GPX waypoint (35.787783,-118.071883), not an allowed source, so left unplaced; no officialCandidates.

Opened snwburd marion_n1_1: started Taboose Pass TH, over Taboose, South Fork Kings, old Cartridge Pass trail, Cirque Crest (page does not say NE ridge). Opened climber.org 2001/789: Taboose Pass, Cartridge Pass, Lake Basin, Marion Lake (no ridge named, no TH named). Other reports (search results only) come from Big Pine via Marion Lake and Road's End; route text allows Cartridge Pass or Marion Lake. Weak lead: Taboose Pass TH (USFS TABOOSE PASS TH 37.009505,-118.327312), not tied to this route by a page.

Opened climber.org 2005/1428: Westside trailhead at Sunset Meadow near Grant Grove, Cloud Canyon trail to Colby Lake, ramps to summit. Opened climber.org 2010/1764: High Sierra Trail, Crescent Meadow, Elizabeth Pass, Cloud Canyon, via Milestone then east ridge. Search summaries give Road's End via Bubbs Creek/Sphinx Creek/Avalanche Pass. Three starts, none tied to this route; Sunset Meadow and Crescent Meadow not in officialCandidates.
